comment: pickup.c in_container() line 2654: an ice troll corpse that carries its monster's traits goes into an ice box. A debug Valkyrie wears wished gauntlets of power (St 25) so she can lift 1000 weight, drops a wished ice box, kills a created ice troll with #wizkill (a large monster always leaves a corpse, and make_corpse() saves its traits as OMONST), picks the corpse up, returns to the box and stashes the corpse with #loot s. in_container() stops the corpse's timers and, because corpsenm is PM_ICE_TROLL and has_omonst() holds, clears OMONST(obj)->mcan at 2654. The final keys dismiss the --More-- and the encumbrance message.
